authority: 2026-10-19 direct user: physical-field-defined budget, plan and independent review only
origin: each own E023 joint10000 seed7; never a D012-corrected or E024 head-tail origin
budget: max(full nodal UV change / origin FEM UV error, full GP engineering-strain change / origin FEM strain error, full GP instantaneous elastic-driver change / origin FEM driver error, native dual free-force change / origin force norm) <= eta
budget_center: immutable own E023 origin, including after relinearization
normalization: raw dimensional norm of own origin error; force uses same rho scaling; no FEM-near-zero denominator or arbitrary epsilon floor
guard_ceiling: own E023 origin squared error / weak norm squared, no actual physical slack
background_cost_primary: 0 allowed aggregate error increase in background and inside-background UV, strain and elastic driver; not pointwise protection or application tolerance

diagnostic_ablation.purpose: separate extra strain/full-damage-driver protection cost from field-budget benefit; never admitted as primary repair

solver.method: SciPy SLSQP, analytical objective and constraint Jacobians, full568 variables, one zero increment start
solver.preconditioner: invertible eigenscale of exact full nodal UV + engineering-strain change Grams; floor1e-10*lambda_max only in coordinate transform, no rank truncation or parameter penalty
solver.line_search: first actual feasible with positive actual improvement and actual/predicted reduction >= .1
solver.unresolved_inner_return: finite proxy-feasible may furnish an actual feasible witness; never a ceiling or converged optimum

resource_caps.processes: serial fresh process per state; no repeated loader after large arrays

future_execution_permissions: implementation + exact-source Code Ready and a separately approved final execution scope required; current design review is not launch permission
